title: VariantCentrifuge
description: VariantCentrifuge is a research-use command-line pipeline for filtering, extracting, and prioritizing genetic variants from VCF files. It combines gene-centric region extraction, multi-tier filtering, inheritance analysis, configurable scoring, association testing, and report generation.
